evidence.claim: Walmart discloses private brands in Walmart U.S. and supplier-facing offerings including advertising solutions, supply-chain and fulfillment capabilities, and data analytics and insights for suppliers and brands.

SPS Commerce describes itself as a leading intelligent supply-chain network connecting trading partners globally, with more than 50,000 recurring-revenue customers across retail, grocery, distribution, supply, manufacturing and logistics.
SPS Commerce markets its network as connecting suppliers to retail partners and supporting EDI, order processes, product setup and sales-performance workflows across retail supply chains.

TreeHouse Foods describes itself as a leading private-brands snacking and beverage manufacturer in North America and says it manufactures and sells private-label foods and beverages for retail grocery, foodservice and co-pack customers.

Advantage Solutions' 2025 10-K describes services supporting manufacturer relationships with retailers, including sales planning, distribution optimization, pricing and promotional strategy, category recommendations, in-store merchandising execution, private brands and retail-media initiatives.
External search context argues that private-label and AI-mediated channel shifts can turn retail shelf access from routine sales execution into a critical dependency for consumer brands.
evidence.source_title: When Critical Dependencies Break the Operating Model

memory_update.text: SPSC should remain in the retail shelf-access/private-label node as a non-obvious software/data plumbing candidate tied to retailer-supplier integration, EDI, product setup and replenishment workflows.
THS is the cleanest public private-label manufacturer candidate found in this pass; key survival tests are customer concentration, margin resilience and evidence of retailer program wins.

ADV is a speculative-shadow candidate for category management, private-brand advisory, retail media and merchandising execution; require proof of material exposure and financial quality before promotion.
WMT is the reference control point for this node because it combines private brands, retail media, supplier data analytics, fulfillment capabilities and physical/digital shelf access.

Need further Layer 1B/1C searches for additional public private-label manufacturers in household/personal care, packaging suppliers tied to retailer private brands, shelf-audit/data providers, and national brands with high retailer concentration as negative comps.

node: Retail shelf access, private-label displacement and category control
summary: Layer 1B expands the direct public-company universe around retailer shelf access, private-label displacement and category control. The reference lane is Walmart as the obvious asset owner and demand/control point: it owns shelf space, private brands, supplier data/analytics, retail media and fulfillment infrastructure. The underfollowed lane prioritizes companies that sit inside retailer-controlled programs rather than consumer-facing brands: SPS Commerce as retail EDI/data plumbing, TreeHouse Foods as a scaled private-brand manufacturer, and Advantage Solutions as a retail execution/category/private-brand services provider. These are research candidates only, not recommendations.
